verdict.rationale: Feitian publishes a documentation site (fido.ftsafe.com) with setup and how-to guides, so asking whether those docs are offered as llms.txt or in an agent-oriented format is a fair question. The pack contains no evidence of an llms.txt file, a markdown or agent-oriented doc variant, or any machine-readable docs index. The only probe checked OpenAPI paths, which all returned 404, and did not test llms.txt.
